candidates.label: Sincerity in religion as the condition of the worship command
candidates.definition: In 39:2-3: We sent down the Book in truth, so worship Allah being sincere to Him in religion; unquestionably for Allah is the pure religion.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ فَٱعۡبُدِ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصٗا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: أَلَا لِلَّهِ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلۡخَالِصُۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَ مَا نَعۡبُدُهُمۡ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ زُلۡفَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ فِي مَا هُمۡ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي مَنۡ هُوَ كَٰذِبٞ كَفَّارٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Intermediary worship pleaded as seeking nearness, reserved for divine judgement
candidates.definition: In 39:3: Those who take protectors besides Him say we only worship them that they may bring us nearer to Allah in position; Allah will judge between them concerning that over which they differ.

evidence.excerpt: أَلَا لِلَّهِ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلۡخَالِصُۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَ مَا نَعۡبُدُهُمۡ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ زُلۡفَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ فِي مَا هُمۡ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي مَنۡ هُوَ كَٰذِبٞ كَفَّارٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Divine sonship refuted through freedom of choice, affirming Oneness and Prevailing power
candidates.definition: In 39:4: If Allah had intended to take a son He could have chosen from what He creates whatever He willed; exalted is He, He is Allah the One the Prevailing.

evidence.excerpt: لَّوۡ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدٗا لَّٱصۡطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥۖ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡوَٰحِدُ ٱلۡقَهَّارُ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Staged creation in the wombs within three darknesses
candidates.definition: In 39:6: He created you from one soul then made from it its mate, and produced eight mates of grazing livestock; He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses.

evidence.excerpt: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفۡسٖ وَٰحِدَةٖ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۡهَا زَوۡجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ ثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَزۡوَٰجٖۚ يَخۡلُقُكُمۡ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡ خَلۡقٗا مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ خَلۡقٖ فِي ظُلُمَٰتٖ ثَلَٰثٖۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمۡ لَهُ ٱلۡمُلۡكُۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصۡرَفُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Divine independence of belief with approval of gratitude and individual burden-bearing
candidates.definition: In 39:7: If you disbelieve, Allah is Free from need of you, and He does not approve disbelief for His servants; if you are grateful He approves it; no bearer of burdens bears another's burden.

evidence.excerpt: إِن تَكۡفُرُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنكُمۡۖ وَلَا يَرۡضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ ٱلۡكُفۡرَۖ وَإِن تَشۡكُرُواْ يَرۡضَهُ لَكُمۡۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٞ وِزۡرَ أُخۡرَىٰۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Night devotion contrasted with heedlessness and knowledge with ignorance
candidates.definition: In 39:9: Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing, fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, like one who does not? Say, are those who know equal to those who do not know?

evidence.excerpt: أَمَّنۡ هُوَ قَٰنِتٌ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيۡلِ سَاجِدٗا وَقَآئِمٗا يَحۡذَرُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ وَيَرۡجُواْ رَحۡمَةَ رَبِّهِۦۗ قُلۡ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِي ٱلَّذِينَ يَعۡلَمُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَۗ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Commissioned sincerity and precedence in submission with fear of the tremendous Day
candidates.definition: In 39:11-13: I have been commanded to worship Allah sincere in religion and to be the first of the Muslims; say I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَعۡبُدَ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصٗا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَأُمِرۡتُ لِأَنۡ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ إِنۡ عَصَيۡتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Loss defined as forfeiting oneself and one's family at resurrection
candidates.definition: In 39:15: Indeed the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection; that is the manifest loss.

evidence.excerpt: فَٱعۡبُدُواْ مَا شِئۡتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦۗ قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَأَهۡلِيهِمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۗ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡخُسۡرَانُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Avoidance of Taghut and return to Allah earning glad tidings
candidates.definition: In 39:17: Those who have avoided Taghut lest they worship it and turned back to Allah, for them are good tidings; so give good tidings to My servants.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱجۡتَنَبُواْ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتَ أَن يَعۡبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ لَهُمُ ٱلۡبُشۡرَىٰۚ فَبَشِّرۡ عِبَادِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Hearing speech and following its best as the criterion of guidance
candidates.definition: In 39:18: Who listen to speech and follow the best of it; those are the ones Allah has guided and those are people of understanding.

evidence.excerpt: ٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحۡسَنَهُۥٓۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُۖ وَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: The agricultural cycle from rain to withered debris as reminder
candidates.definition: In 39:21: Allah sends down rain and makes it flow as springs in the earth, then produces crops of varying colors, then they dry and turn yellow, then He makes them scattered debris; indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding.

evidence.excerpt: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَسَلَكَهُۥ يَنَٰبِيعَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ثُمَّ يُخۡرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرۡعٗا مُّخۡتَلِفًا أَلۡوَٰنُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصۡفَرّٗا ثُمَّ يَجۡعَلُهُۥ حُطَٰمًاۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكۡرَىٰ لِأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: The expanded breast upon divine light against hearts hardened to remembrance
candidates.definition: In 39:22: Is one whose breast Allah has expanded to accept Islam and he is upon a light from his Lord like one whose heart rejects it? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allah.

evidence.excerpt: أَفَمَن شَرَحَ ٱللَّهُ صَدۡرَهُۥ لِلۡإِسۡلَٰمِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورٖ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦۚ فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلۡقَٰسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مِّن ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: The best statement as a reiterated Book affecting skin and heart
candidates.definition: In 39:23: Allah has sent down the best statement, a consistent Book wherein is reiteration; the skins shiver of those who fear their Lord, then their skins and hearts relax at the remembrance of Allah.

evidence.excerpt: ٱللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلۡحَدِيثِ كِتَٰبٗا مُّتَشَٰبِهٗا مَّثَانِيَ تَقۡشَعِرُّ مِنۡهُ جُلُودُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُمۡ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمۡ وَقُلُوبُهُمۡ إِلَىٰ ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهۡدِي بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡ هَادٍ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Comprehensive parables in an unambiguous Arabic Quran aimed at remembrance and taqwa
candidates.definition: In 39:27-28: We have presented for the people in this Quran every kind of example that they might remember; an Arabic Quran without any deviance that they might become righteous.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَقَدۡ ضَرَبۡنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٖ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيۡرَ ذِي عِوَجٖ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Ownership parable contrasting divided and exclusive mastership
candidates.definition: In 39:29: Allah presents an example, a slave owned by quarreling partners and another belonging exclusively to one man; are they equal in comparison?

evidence.excerpt: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا رَّجُلٗا فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ مُتَشَٰكِسُونَ وَرَجُلٗا سَلَمٗا لِّرَجُلٍ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًاۚ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Universal mortality followed by dispute before the Lord
candidates.definition: In 39:30-31: Indeed you are to die and indeed they are to die; then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord will dispute.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٞ وَإِنَّهُم مَّيِّتُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ عِندَ رَبِّكُمۡ تَخۡتَصِمُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Removal of the worst deeds and recompense according to the best
candidates.definition: In 39:34-35: They will have whatever they desire with their Lord, that is the reward of the doers of good, that Allah may remove from them the worst of what they did and reward them for the best of what they used to do.

evidence.excerpt: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡۚ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: لِيُكَفِّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ أَسۡوَأَ ٱلَّذِي عَمِلُواْ وَيَجۡزِيَهُمۡ أَجۡرَهُم بِأَحۡسَنِ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Divine sufficiency against threats, with exclusive reliance after the harm-and-mercy challenge
candidates.definition: In 39:36-38: Is not Allah sufficient for His servant? If Allah intended me harm, are they removers of His harm, or if He intended mercy, are they withholders of His mercy? Say, sufficient for me is Allah; upon Him alone rely the reliers.

evidence.excerpt: أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبۡدَهُۥۖ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦۚ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡ هَادٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَن يَهۡدِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّضِلٍّۗ أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِعَزِيزٖ ذِي ٱنتِقَامٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۚ قُلۡ أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِنۡ أَرَادَنِيَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلۡ هُنَّ كَٰشِفَٰتُ ضُرِّهِۦٓ أَوۡ أَرَادَنِي بِرَحۡمَةٍ هَلۡ هُنَّ مُمۡسِكَٰتُ رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ قُلۡ حَسۡبِيَ ٱللَّهُۖ عَلَيۡهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ ٱلۡمُتَوَكِّلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Guidance and straying returning to the soul with no prophetic managership
candidates.definition: In 39:41: We sent down the Book for the people in truth; whoever is guided, it is for the benefit of his soul, and whoever goes astray only goes astray to its detriment; and you are not a manager over them.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ لِلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ فَمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ فَلِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيۡهَاۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِوَكِيلٍ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Benefit and detriment to the nafs.

candidates.label: Souls taken at death and in sleep with retention or release to a term
candidates.definition: In 39:42: Allah takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die during their sleep; then He keeps those for which He has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term.

evidence.excerpt: ٱللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلۡأَنفُسَ حِينَ مَوۡتِهَا وَٱلَّتِي لَمۡ تَمُتۡ فِي مَنَامِهَاۖ فَيُمۡسِكُ ٱلَّتِي قَضَىٰ عَلَيۡهَا ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَيُرۡسِلُ ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمًّىۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Intercession reserved wholly to Allah against powerless intercessors
candidates.definition: In 39:43-44: Have they taken other than Allah as intercessors? Say, even though they do not possess anything nor do they reason? Say, to Allah belongs intercession entirely.

evidence.excerpt: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ شُفَعَآءَۚ قُلۡ أَوَلَوۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: قُل لِّلَّهِ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ جَمِيعٗاۖ لَّهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Aversion at the mention of Allah alone against joy at rivals
candidates.definition: In 39:45: When Allah is mentioned alone the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion, but when those worshipped other than Him are mentioned, immediately they rejoice.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَحۡدَهُ ٱشۡمَأَزَّتۡ قُلُوبُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِذَا هُمۡ يَسۡتَبۡشِرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Linked to disbelief in the Hereafter.

candidates.label: Prosperity misread as knowledge-based entitlement rather than trial
candidates.definition: In 39:49: When adversity touches man he calls upon Us; then when We bestow a favor he says I have only been given it because of my knowledge; rather it is a trial, but most of them do not know.

evidence.excerpt: فَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ ضُرّٞ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلۡنَٰهُ نِعۡمَةٗ مِّنَّا قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أُوتِيتُهُۥ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمِۭۚ بَلۡ هِيَ فِتۡنَةٞ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Prohibition of despair for self-transgressing servants because all sins are forgiven
candidates.definition: In 39:53: Say, O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah; indeed Allah forgives all sins; indeed it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

evidence.excerpt: ۞قُلۡ يَٰعِبَادِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسۡرَفُواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ لَا تَقۡنَطُواْ مِن رَّحۡمَةِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغۡفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًاۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Repentance and following the best revelation urged before sudden punishment
candidates.definition: In 39:54-55: Return in repentance to your Lord and submit to Him before the punishment comes upon you; and follow the best of what was revealed to you from your Lord before the punishment comes suddenly while you do not perceive.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَنِيبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمۡ وَأَسۡلِمُواْ لَهُۥ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَكُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱتَّبِعُوٓاْ أَحۡسَنَ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُم مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَكُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ بَغۡتَةٗ وَأَنتُمۡ لَا تَشۡعُرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Threefold regret answered by the arrival of denied verses
candidates.definition: In 39:56-59: Lest a soul say oh my regret over what I neglected in regard to Allah; or if only Allah had guided me; or if only I had another turn; but yes, there had come to you My verses, but you denied them and were arrogant.

evidence.excerpt: أَن تَقُولَ نَفۡسٞ يَٰحَسۡرَتَىٰ عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطتُ فِي جَنۢبِ ٱللَّهِ وَإِن كُنتُ لَمِنَ ٱلسَّـٰخِرِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: أَوۡ تَقُولَ لَوۡ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هَدَىٰنِي لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: أَوۡ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرَى ٱلۡعَذَابَ لَوۡ أَنَّ لِي كَرَّةٗ فَأَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: بَلَىٰ قَدۡ جَآءَتۡكَ ءَايَٰتِي فَكَذَّبۡتَ بِهَا وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرۡتَ وَكُنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Shirk voiding all work, answered by the command to worship and be grateful
candidates.definition: In 39:65-66: It was revealed to you and to those before you that if you should associate anything with Allah your work would surely become worthless; rather worship only Allah and be among the grateful.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَقَدۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِكَ لَئِنۡ أَشۡرَكۡتَ لَيَحۡبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: بَلِ ٱللَّهَ فَٱعۡبُدۡ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلشَّـٰكِرِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Inadequate appraisal corrected by the earth in His grip and heavens folded in His right hand
candidates.definition: In 39:67: They have not appraised Allah with true appraisal, while the earth entirely will be within His grip on the Day of Resurrection and the heavens will be folded in His right hand.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَا قَدَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدۡرِهِۦ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ جَمِيعٗا قَبۡضَتُهُۥ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ مَطۡوِيَّـٰتُۢ بِيَمِينِهِۦۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: The double blast, illuminated earth, placed record and assembled witnesses
candidates.definition: In 39:68-70: The Horn will be blown and all will fall dead except whom Allah wills, then blown again and they stand looking on; the earth will shine with the light of its Lord, the record placed, the prophets and witnesses brought, judged in truth without wrong; every soul fully compensated.

evidence.excerpt: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَصَعِقَ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۖ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِيهِ أُخۡرَىٰ فَإِذَا هُمۡ قِيَامٞ يَنظُرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَشۡرَقَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ بِنُورِ رَبِّهَا وَوُضِعَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ وَجِاْيٓءَ بِٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءِ وَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَوُفِّيَتۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ مَّا عَمِلَتۡ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَفۡعَلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Grouped drivings to Hell and Paradise with their keepers' words
candidates.definition: In 39:71-75: Those who disbelieved driven to Hell in groups whose keepers ask about the messengers; those who feared their Lord driven to Paradise in groups greeted with peace and purity; and you will see the angels surrounding the Throne exalting with praise, and it will be said praise to Allah Lord of the worlds.

evidence.excerpt: وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًاۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا فُتِحَتۡ أَبۡوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ رُسُلٞ مِّنكُمۡ يَتۡلُونَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّكُمۡ وَيُنذِرُونَكُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هَٰذَاۚ قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ وَلَٰكِنۡ حَقَّتۡ كَلِمَةُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: قِيلَ ٱدۡخُلُوٓاْ أَبۡوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ فَبِئۡسَ مَثۡوَى ٱلۡمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ رَبَّهُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡجَنَّةِ زُمَرًاۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا وَفُتِحَتۡ أَبۡوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡ طِبۡتُمۡ فَٱدۡخُلُوهَا خَٰلِدِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَالُواْ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي صَدَقَنَا وَعۡدَهُۥ وَأَوۡرَثَنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ نَتَبَوَّأُ مِنَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ حَيۡثُ نَشَآءُۖ فَنِعۡمَ أَجۡرُ ٱلۡعَٰمِلِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَتَرَى ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ حَآفِّينَ مِنۡ حَوۡلِ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡۚ وَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ وَقِيلَ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.
